app.name: Now playing
app.summary: Shows the current song of a media player, with a progress bar and buttons.
app.opt_action_hint: What this tile does when you tap it.
app.opt_cover_hint: Shows the cover beside the title, from two cells wide, if the screen can show pictures.
app.opt_controls_hint: Previous, play/pause and next under the title. Needs a tile of two rows or more.
app.opt_volume_hint: Quieter and louder under the title. Needs a tile of two rows or more.
app.opt_timeline_hint: How far the song has played: as a bar, as the time, or both. Needs a player that reports the position.
app.opt_voldisp_hint: Shows the volume at the title's right.
